from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u084/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(g) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
    colors = {v for row in g for v in row} - {1, 2, 8}
    # The moving object is the non-background color; background is the most frequent non-divider color.
    counts = {}
    for row in g:
        for v in row:
            if v != 2:
                counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    obj_color = next(v for v in counts if v != background)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == obj_color]
    lo, hi = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    if hi < divider:
        dr = divider - 1 - hi
        trail = lo + dr - 1
    else:
        dr = divider + 1 - lo
        trail = hi + dr + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for r, c in points:
        out[r][c] = background
    for r, c in points:
        out[r + dr][c] = obj_color
    if 0 <= trail < h:
        out[trail] = [8] * w
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-ca63d1db.py'; p.write_text(code)
